summary: The previously-found Leviticus 10 narrative-fact error is now corrected (cousins carried out Nadab/Abihu, Aaron forbidden to mourn or leave the door); all 16 KJV quotes are verbatim against the source, the two-goat typology is sound, and the piece lands on Christ with a grace-anchored CTA.

findings.quote_or_claim: Stack of consecutive NT/OT proof-quotes (Heb 10:3, Heb 10:4, Heb 9:12, Isa 53:6, Heb 13:12, Heb 10:12, Matt 27:51)
findings.problem: Beat 6 leans heavily on a dense chain of back-to-back signposted cross-time Scripture quotes (the EW-INV-11 device); doctrinally and verbatim clean, but pacing-heavy — the second panel flagged this as a craft/quote-density concern, not a doctrinal one. Does not change the verdict.
findings.proposed_fix_text: Optional: break the quote run with one short line of Aaron's own reflection between the Heb 13:12 "without the gate" quote and the Heb 10:12 "sat down" quote to let the reveal breathe.
